title: Cute and comfy house in East Nashville!
description:
This cute cottage is perfect for your Nashville experience! Located just a few blocks from Five Points in East Nashville, this home is a short walk or bike ride to all the hot spots. Enjoy comfortable accommodations for four including a fully equipped kitchen. Just across the river from downtown!

The space
One bedroom house walking distance to Five Points! Cute and comfy, nicely appointed, high speed Wifi included. Accommodations for four including a wonderful king bed and queen sleeper sofa. Fully equipped kitchen with all the essentials, this home has everything you need. Easy access to East Nashville hot spots and Nissan Stadium, ride your bike or quick Lyft/Uber/taxi downtown.

Guest access
This is your own private home, you have full access to the house, covered parking and private yard.

Other things to note
High speed Wifi included, this home has everything you need!
